decisionTitle: Go toolchain (1.19.8) installed via apt to run tests; older than go.mod's go 1.21 directive
rationale: The environment had no Go compiler available, so `go test ./internal/convert/length/...` could not be run to verify the implementation. Installed `golang-go` from the Debian bookworm apt repo (go1.19.8) to build and run tests. The available version is older than the `go 1.21` directive in go.mod, but the module uses no 1.21-only language/stdlib features, so `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` for the whole repository succeed cleanly with it. Implemented internal/convert/length/length.go with an unexported factors map (mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, mi) converting to metres, and Convert(value, from, to) returning apperr.InputError for negative value (FR-19) or unknown from/to unit codes, otherwise value*factor(from)/factor(to) unrounded. Added internal/convert/length/length_test.go covering successful conversions across several unit pairs, negative value rejection, and unknown from/unknown to rejection. Full repo test suite (go test ./...) passes, including previously existing internal/convert/mass and internal/convert/temperature packages.
